title: Zapier vs. Airtable: Which is best? [2026]
summary: Here's a full comparison to help you understand Zapier's and Airtable's strengths, how to choose between them, and the situations where it makes sense to use them together.
body_markdown:
**Zapier**


**Airtable**


**Ease of use**


Thousands of templates; visual workflow builder; Zapier Copilot can build complex automations and multi-product workflows using natural language prompts


Hundreds of templates; Omni AI assistant handles app creation; third-party integrations and advanced automations can be challenging


**Integrations**


9,000+


integrations


~30 native integrations and ~160 third-party extensions


**Automation**


Unlimited automations with conditional paths, data formatting, and trigger scheduling; sophisticated cross-platform workflows


Limited automations on each base; best for internal workflows; advanced automations and external connectors are limited


**AI access (MCP)**


Zapier MCP connects AI tools to 9,000+


apps via a single governed connection


Airtable MCP server connects AI tools directly to your Airtable bases; scoped to Airtable data only


**Database**


[Tables](https://zapier.com/tables) offers lightweight data storage that integrates seamlessly with Zapier workflows; limit of 500,000 records per account for Team, custom for Enterprise


Up to 500,000 records per base on the Enterprise plan, or 100M+ records with HyperDB; relational database with linked records, lookups, and multiple views


**Features**


Automations, databases, forms,[process mapping](https://zapier.com/blog/process-mapping) , agents, and chatbots; Zapier Copilot AI assistant


Databases, automations, interfaces, agents, and portals; Omni AI assistant


**Enterprise security**


SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, GDPR, SAML SSO, audit logs, role-based access control, AES-256 encryption, SCIM, 99.9% uptime


SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, SAML SSO, audit logs, role-based access controls, AES-256 encryption


**Pricing**


Task-based pricing starting at $19.99/month for solo users and $69/month for teams of up to 25 users; Enterprise pricing is custom


Per-seat pricing starting at $20/month per user for the Team plan or $45/month per user for the Business plan; custom-priced Enterprise Scale plan
